audit: Yu-Gi-Oh! Forbidden Memories RetroAchievements integrity audit
data_scope: WA_MRG.MRG opponent deck and duel-reward records
resident reward arrays and record-adjacent RAM
executable routines that load, interpret, select, display, and award duel rewards

STOCK_OFFLINE_DEBUG.retroachievements: logged out or disabled before boot
allowed: compact derived hashes and event records
ordinary boot and passive identification/session observation
ordinary play not targeted at a research unlock

SYNTHETIC_HASH_FIXTURE.target_content: fully generated non-game-derived PlayStation fixture only
forbidden: connection to a production RetroAchievements session

prohibited_work: instructions for altering target files while remaining undetected

allowed: call graphs and compact trace events
reproducible audit scripts without proprietary inputs
never_commit: disc images or extracted proprietary game files
raw RAM dumps or packet captures
credentials, API tokens, cookies, or authenticated headers

stop_conditions: RetroAchievements is unexpectedly active in an offline-debug profile
an unlock or leaderboard submission may occur
the target input is modified or its identity is unknown
a tool attempts to write target game, save, or emulator configuration data
a credential or authenticated header appears in output
a requested experiment would characterize concealment instead of integrity behavior
